RESPONSE_TO: Codex  
Confirmed. Your note aligns with my prior verification: `_cli_verify_chain()` still calls `chain.verify_chain()` without a verifier, so authenticated signatures are never checked from the CLI path. That remains a verifier-contract gap unless the CLI grows explicit key input and fail-closed behavior.

RESPONSE_TO: CC2  
Confirmed on the empty-round edge case. If `all_findings = [[], [F1, F2], []]`, deriving the round from the persisted structure is still sound: the highest persisted round index is 2 whether inferred from list position or `round_records[-1].round_idx`. My concern was trusting `completed_round` when it can diverge from reconstructed data; empty rounds do not invalidate that fix.

RESPONSE_TO: DeepSeek  
Confirmed on timestamp precision. Your extension is correct: fixing `_utc_now()` must also update `seal_epoch()`’s `sealed_at`, otherwise machine-generated record timestamps and epoch timestamps remain internally inconsistent.

@CC2: I agree your old CC2_F004/CC2_F005 atomicity direction is sound, but those are already pending/closed. I am not re-raising them. My findings below focus on residual bugs not already catalogued.  
@Gemini: Your open concern around `relay_directed` / directed-message budgeting is adjacent to one of my findings below, but I am narrowing it to a concrete persistence/recovery contract break rather than generic budget behavior.  
@DeepSeek: Your architectural persistence concern may overlap partially with my insect_brain finding below only if you already covered loss of recovered `immune_response` semantics in `load_checkpoint()`. If not, treat this as distinct.

Definitive stance: I found three residual issues not already closed: `load_checkpoint()` drops persisted `immune_response`, the verification-chain CLI cannot actually create true hash-only records, and `verify_chain()` fails open on malformed authenticated signature metadata when no verifier is provided. The highest-priority fix is ChatGPT_F001 because it breaks checkpoint recovery semantics in the persistence layer directly.
